about: The placeholder a rendered manifest carries in place of a private key, which keys of a manifest still hold it (`keys`), and which annotations hold a record blanked the same way, with the keys blanked in each (`copies`). A manifest with `keys` is never sent: a ConfigMap would store the placeholder as the key. An annotation in `copies` is left out of what is sent: stored, the placeholder would replace the record kubectl keeps. Rust: `WITHHELD_MARKER`, `still_withheld` and `withheld_copy` in src/tauri/src/resources/tls.rs and the guard in `parse_all_documents` (src/tauri/src/commands/manifest/parse.rs). TypeScript: `WITHHELD_MARKER` in src/ui/lib/withheld.ts, `withheldKeysIn` and `withheldCopiesIn` in src/ui/routes/c/$cluster/-yaml/manifest-reads.ts, which name both before Apply is offered.
marker: <withheld: the app never shows a private key>

cases.name: a ConfigMap as the editor shows it
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;
  server.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: every map a key can sit in
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: bundle
  namespace: shop
binaryData:
  bundle.p12: "<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"
stringData:
  id_rsa: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: a Secret, whose data the server would refuse anyway
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tls
  namespace: shop
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: Y2VydA==
  tls.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: reflowed into a block scalar
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  server.key: |
    <withheld: the app never shows a private key>

cases.name: in the second document of two
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: a
  namespace: shop
data:
  a: b
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: b
  namespace: shop
data:
  client.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: the withheld key removed from the manifest
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;

cases.name: a value that only mentions the placeholder
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: notes
  namespace: shop
data:
  readme: "the app prints <withheld: the app never shows a private key> for a key"

cases.name: the placeholder outside the maps a key is read from
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: notes
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    note: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'
data:
  a: b

cases.name: the record kubectl keeps, blanked, with the key itself taken out of the manifest
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    team: edge
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"v1","data":{"nginx.conf":"worker_processes 2;","server.key":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"},"kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"annotations":{},"name":"nginx","namespace":"shop"}}
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;

cases.name: the blanked record beside the placeholder still under data
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"v1","data":{"nginx.conf":"worker_processes 2;","server.key":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"},"kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"annotations":{},"name":"nginx","namespace":"shop"}}
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;
  server.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: a Secret's record blanked under stringData, on one quoted line
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: deploy
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: '{"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"Secret","metadata":{"name":"deploy","namespace":"shop"},"stringData":{"id_rsa":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>","user":"git"}}'
data:
  user: Z2l0

cases.name: a record with no key in it
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"v1","data":{"nginx.conf":"worker_processes 2;"},"kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"annotations":{},"name":"nginx","namespace":"shop"}}
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;

cases.name: another tool's record, blanked in two maps
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: bundle
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    kapp.k14s.io/original: '{"apiVersion":"v1","binaryData":{"bundle.p12":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"},"data":{"client.key":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"},"kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"name":"bundle"}}'
data:
  a: b

cases.name: a record that holds another record
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: moved
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    kapp.k14s.io/original: '{"kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"annotations":{"kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration":"{\"kind\":\"ConfigMap\",\"data\":{\"tls.key\":\"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>\"}}"},"name":"moved"}}'
data:
  a: b

cases.name: an annotation that is not an object and only quotes the placeholder
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: notes
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    list: '[{"data":{"server.key":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"}}]'
    broken: '{"data":{"server.key":"<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"'
data:
  a: b
